Home.storyBody: Kithul & Co. started with one rule: cook it the way it's cooked at home. Curry powder roasted and ground every morning, coconut milk pressed fresh, and kithul treacle from the same family in Sinharaja for three generations.

About.title: Our story
About.lead: We cook the food we grew up eating, and we don't take shortcuts.
About.p1: Kithul & Co. began in 2014 as a twelve-seat lunch room off Flower Road. Our founder's grandmother ran a kitchen in Galle that fed half the street, and her recipe book, stained with turmeric and annotated in three languages, is still on the pass today.
About.p2: Every morning our cooks roast and grind the curry powder, press coconut milk by hand and start the stocks for lamprais. The kithul treacle in our wattalappan and curd comes from the same tappers in the Sinharaja foothills we have bought from since the beginning.
About.p3: Twelve years on we have three kitchens, in Colombo 07, Nugegoda and Kandy. The rooms are bigger, but the rule hasn't changed: if it isn't how it's made at home, it doesn't go on the menu.
About.value1Body: Curry powders, sambols and coconut milk are made in-house each morning.
About.value2Body: Halal, vegetarian, vegan and nut information on every dish, and staff who can answer questions.
About.value3Body: Fish from the morning market, vegetables from Dambulla and treacle from the same families for twelve years.

Contact.title: Get in touch
Contact.subtitle: For orders, call your nearest branch. For everything else, we're happy to help.
Contact.eventsBody: Planning an almsgiving, birthday, office lunch or wedding? Message us with the date, guest count and location.

delivery.a: Each branch delivers within a set distance, shown on the branches page. At checkout we check your pin on the map and match you with the nearest branch that delivers to you.

fees.a: There is a base fee for the first few kilometres and a small charge per kilometre after that. Delivery is free on larger orders. You'll see the exact fee before you pay.

payment.a: Cash on delivery, or by card or mobile wallet through PayHere, Sri Lanka's secure payment gateway. We never see or store your card details.

charges.q: Why is there a service charge?
charges.a: As at most Sri Lankan restaurants, a {serviceCharge}% service charge is added to the bill and shared among the team. VAT is added as required by law. Your bill shows every line clearly.

dietary.q: Do you cater for dietary needs?
dietary.a: Every dish is marked if it is vegetarian, vegan, halal or contains nuts, and you can filter the menu by these. If you have a serious allergy, please call the branch before ordering.

spice.a: Properly hot. Mild suits most children and visitors, Medium is how we'd serve it at home, and Sri Lankan Hot is for those who like to sweat.

poya.q: Do you serve alcohol on Poya days?
poya.a: No. In keeping with the law and tradition, our bar is closed on every Full Moon Poya day. We serve a vegetarian lunch special instead.

bookings.a: Yes. Book online or call the branch. For groups of more than twelve, please call so we can arrange the room.

catering.q: Do you cater for almsgivings and events?
catering.a: We do, from small danas to weddings and homecomings. Get in touch with the date, guest count and location and we'll send you a menu and quote.
